Class NostrRTCPeer

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.rtc.signal.NostrRTCPeer
Direct Known Subclasses:
NostrRTCLocalPeer
public class NostrRTCPeer extends Object
Creates a new peer with the given information.

A peer is uniquely identified by the tuple (pubkey, applicationId, protocolId, sessionId, roomPubkey). This combination is used to route messages to the correct peer and to distinguish between multiple sessions from the same pubkey.

Note: All fields except pubkey and roomPubkey can be freely chosen by applications. If two different applications donnect to a public room sharing the same user signer, they may impersonate one another. If this is a concern, generate a random keypair and use that instead of the user-provided one (authentication can be handled off-protocol).

  • Constructor Details

    • NostrRTCPeer

      public NostrRTCPeer(NostrPublicKey pubkey, String applicationId, String protocolId, String sessionId, NostrPublicKey roomPubkey, @Nullable String turnServer)
      Creates a new peer with the given information.
      Parameters:
      pubkey - Peer's public key (must not be null)
      applicationId - Application ID (e.g., "com.myapp.rtc") (must not be null)
      protocolId - Protocol ID used by the application (e.g., "mygame-01") (must not be null)
      sessionId - Session ID (unique per peer session, e.g., random UUID created on application startup) (must not be null)
      roomPubkey - Room public key (identifies the room the peer is in) (must not be null)
      turnServer - TURN server URL, or null if unknown
